recipe.loss: author sequence_loss re-implemented at training/n01_motion.py::sequence_loss; gamma**(n-i-1) iteration weights, masked mean per iteration, mag<max_flow exclusion, packed-cell unit for both prediction and target
recipe.optimizer: AdamW(lr from selection, weight_decay=1e-4, eps=1e-8), clip_grad=1.0, gamma=0.8, bf16 autocast on CUDA

smoke_chain_minimal_config.resume: loaded update 2 of 4; next batch identity and per-update loss equal to the continuous run in the unit test
smoke_chain_minimal_config.note: the smoke model is trained for two updates only; its EPE is not a research result

remote_bundle_gap.required_action: re-bundle (or overlay) the five files listed in files_sha256 before the remote run

remote_command_sequence.environment: new encoder env with CUDA torch and Python >= 3.11; PYTHONPATH=<snapshot>/src

known_differences_and_risks: the vendored tree ships no core/loss.py, so sequence_loss is re-implemented with the fetched upstream sha256 recorded in the module docstring; the only declared difference is a mask-sum clamp so an empty mask contributes zero instead of NaN
no upstream pretrained or ImageNet weights are loaded (model.pretrained_checkpoint = null); every seed starts from its seeded random initialisation

the shipped noise-config geometry is 64x64 sensor (32x32 packed), below the vendored 4-level correlation pyramid minimum of 128 packed cells at iters>0; the training config overrides to 256x256 sensor and scales every pixel-valued recipe length by 4 (translation_subpixel tokens stay absolute)
LR drops are declared at absolute updates (50k, 80k); extending a resumed run therefore replays the same LR trajectory instead of moving phase boundaries
checkpoint size is ~226 MB per file (19.7M params + AdamW moments); last.pt is overwritten every 1000 updates and best.pt on every improvement

validation_plateau is a stop condition, not a quality verdict: a run whose validation only degrades also has 'no improvements' for eight checks; the receipt carries the whole validation history and the best checkpoint

the old_simplified arm is a global integer correlation alignment on the delivered RAW planes (the old align_planes path needs a given offset field, so this arm supplies it); its variance shortcut is not reused
the evaluation caps region sizes case-balanced so every case (and every bucket) keeps at least one pair

d1_platform_criteria_fix.defect: D1: decide_platform accepted a constant or monotonically degrading validation curve as validation_plateau
fix: flat_tail_below_delta_val stays literal: slow persistent improvement below delta_val is still a plateau
d1_platform_criteria_fix.operational_note: decide_platform is called only with the validation history; the fix changes neither the training trajectory nor any checkpoint's tensor content. An already-finished run whose old receipt says validation_plateau on a zero-improvement or drifting curve must have its status re-derived (the checkpoint stores val_history/lr_drops, so this is a pure recomputation), and a run that is still executing keeps the old function in memory until restarted; it never needs an update rerun.

later_additions: the rgb3 (pseudo-RAW) dev-scale stem arm and the stem-report entry point were added after this receipt; they change no loss, schedule or checkpoint semantics, so the platform statuses recorded here are unaffected. See motion-train-eval-stem-rgb3.json
